blocks.html: The Board of Standards and Appeals is authorized to issue a variance for the construction or substantial improvement of a functionally dependent facility provided the criteria in Sections G105.3, G105.5 and G105.7 are met and the variance is the minimum necessary to allow the construction or substantial improvement, and that all due consideration has been given to methods and materials that minimize flood damages during the base flood and create no additional threats to public safety.
